description: Check whether this machine can run the Flisk stack (Docker, Tilt, ports). Read-only. Pass problemsOnly: true for concise diagnostics (drops passing checks, adds summary counts); recommended for agents. Optionally set projectPath to include checks for a specific Flisk project; for local-process services that also reports missing node_modules/.venv with the exact install command, and hints at a .env in another git worktree with the copy command (it never copies). Returns data.ready and data.host.canUp; run it before `up`. For the state of a running stack use `status`; for whether generated files are consistent use `config_verify`. CLI equivalent: `flisk doctor --json`.

noPing.description: Skip pinging running services' health endpoints

problemsOnly.description: Return only failing checks and summary counts; recommended for agents to reduce payload size

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

name: doctor
